meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动将实验室数据集成到 Benchling
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Benchling 中手动操作数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data integration with Benchling.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Benchling data manually.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Python SDK 或 REST API 操作 Benchling 平台的注册实体（DNA/RNA/蛋白质）、库存、电子实验记录（ELN）、工作流、数据中心查询等。
howto.when: 当你要求自动化管理 Benchling 数据，如创建/更新序列、管理容器、操作实验记录或工作流时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 Benchling 中创建一个名为“质粒1”的 DNA 序列。
查询我的库存中所有容器。

howto.what_en: Claude can interact with Benchling platform via Python SDK or REST API to manage registry entities (DNA/RNA/proteins), inventory, ELN entries, workflows, and Data Warehouse queries.
howto.when_en: When you ask to automate Benchling data tasks such as creating/updating sequences, managing containers, operating lab notebook entries, or workflows.

say_en.text: Create a DNA sequence named 'Plasmid1' in Benchling.
say_en.note: Claude will call SDK to create the sequence and return its ID.

say_en.text: List all containers in my inventory.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve and display container info.
